study.question: Can target-relative same-field identity information improve retrieval during field/task evolution without the click regression of action-restricted routing? Observed limitation: incumbent g1-r0001-lowrank_static macro AUC 0.8111782509544756 exceeds DIN 0.8099233880793816, but click AUC is 0.6542716842695201 versus 0.6555440824200336; in the pre-existing >64-history slice it is 0.651291 versus 0.657803 (1,401,885 impressions). This pattern motivates, but does not establish, an addressing bottleneck.
study.hypothesis: Compressing six item fields plus action into 32-dimensional event keys may make explicit target/history correspondence difficult to recover under one-pass optimization. A bounded query-dependent prior over same-field positive-ID matches can expose this information before the field mixers update later queries while retaining the complete global history. The proposed mechanism is target-relative addressing, not extra information or a new capacity path. It is an unverified local hypothesis; originality is unverified.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary arXiv v4 read, including target-dependent local activation and lines 271-277 on unnormalized weights. Target/history relevance is inherited prior art. We use query-adaptive binary field correspondence as an additive logit prior within repeated normalized cross-attention, without DIN local-activation MLP or intensity sum. No broad priority claim.

Pinned 90bb99a source forward and ESTBlocks/LightweightCrossAttention read, lines 119-282. Repeated cross-attention and field transformations are nearest structural precedent. Existing local shared mixers differ from token-specific Q/O and FFNs in that benchmark; the intervention is an explicit same-field match prior inside reads, not the repeated-retrieval stack. This benchmark source is not the original EST method.
Original paper provenance resolved (arXiv 2602.10811), full paper not inspected; no claim of original-paper equivalence or novelty relative to all EST details.

Only the pinned author README was available/read; publisher paper remains unaudited. README states its behavior data has category, brand and action, no item. Our released history has advertisement IDs and more fields; no transfer of DMR item-level assumptions or reported effectiveness is asserted.

study.proposed_difference: Build M[b,l,f]=1 iff both encoded IDs are positive, equal in the SAME one of item_id/cate_id/campaign_id/customer_id/brand, and the history mask is valid. Exclude price and target action. Project original target field embeddings with existing field_projection; reuse existing read Q/K and memory LayerNorm to obtain a per-head softmax over five target fields for each evolving query. Add 2*sum_f(field_weight*M) to event attention logits, bounded [0,2], with a zero null column and hard invalid-key masking. This favors correspondences without excluding mismatching events. Separate scalar I and T switches gate this prior at both internal reads and terminal value pooling. Four standalone modules differ only in those CONFIG booleans; all compute the prior and introduce zero trainable parameters. The factor 2 is fixed prospectively, not screened. No claims of measured improvement or efficiency yet.
predictions: Primary: at least one addressed cell improves full-validation macro AUC over concurrent I0T0. For the claim that address information helps field evolution, internal conditional effects I1T0-I0T0 and I1T1-I0T1 should be positive; report both and interaction, not just the winning cell.

Exploratory diagnostic motivated by existing slices: long-history click AUC should recover toward DIN while retained macro gains are reported per task. Existing empty, 1-16, 17-64 and >64 bins are fixed; report samples and positive/negative counts for every task. No task-specific veto is added.

On fixed identical weights, samples with no positive-ID target/history matches and samples with empty histories should produce identical predictions across all four arms within numerical tolerance. Nonempty matching histories should yield nonzero internal evidence differences when I changes.

All four arms have the incumbent parameter count (expected 32,115,012 total; 321,796 dense), identical declared shapes and comparable executed operations. Runtime may increase due to explicit per-head bias masks; no efficiency benefit is predicted.
falsifiers: Macro AUC fails to improve over concurrent off, or benefit does not survive paired seeds: this implementation lacks supported predictive benefit.
Terminal-only matches/exceeds joint and internal conditional effects are null/negative: the proposed need to expose matching before field evolution is unsupported even if terminal addressing helps.
Future count-preserving wrong-event alignment performs as well as correctly aligned priors: identity-address alignment is not identified as the source of value.

Violation of masked-ID perturbation invariance, current-target-action invariance, finite all-padding/length-zero forward/backward, expected parameter identity, or disabled-parent endpoint agreement invalidates attribution before any performance inference.
Runtime cap or memory failure is an implementation/resource failure, not scientific evidence against explicit matching.
alternative_explanations: Single-seed training and validation selection noise; the incumbent click trade-off and tiny historical off differences are not significance estimates.
An attention concentration or shared-projection regularization effect rather than meaningful field-to-event alignment; reserve a count-preserving valid-event match-vector permutation control.

Category/brand matches may exploit the benchmark auxiliary-label definition rather than solve general history modeling. Labels are same-user/category/brand within 24h, not advertisement-attributed conversions.

The observed long-history click deficit may arise from intensity loss, calibration, task competition, or optimizer dynamics instead of compressed-key addressing. Earlier generic action count injection did not settle these alternatives.

Vocabularies/static snapshots and delayed historical feedback inherit offline assumptions. Positive unknown IDs may collide; only zero-ID exclusion is explicit here. No production causal-validity or cold-start generalization claim.

cost_plan.estimate_ref: g1-r0001-lowrank_static: 839.557s wall, 798.066s train, ~3.943GB peak GPU. g1-r0003-routing_counts_off: 842.665s wall and 32.423s validation inference. Runtime remaining_seconds=27544.608; trial_cap_seconds=1208.541; total campaign 43200s. All work counts; these are existing measured costs, not new candidate timings.
cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Four arms: rough 1000-1150s each if the new float-bias SDPA path stays efficient, not calibrated; reserve four full 1208.541s caps (4834.166s) plus 600s for host preflight/diagnostics. Additional attention work is two internal B*H*Q*5*L products plus one final task-query product and projected target fields; float mask memory/kernel changes can dominate this estimate. Reserve 2*1208.541s (2417.083s) for alignment replacement/repair controls, including failures, only in a later authorized phase. No automatic duplicate runs on unknown status.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Reserve nine complete capped units (10876.872s) for up to three paired validation seeds of the selected cell, closest current control and DIN when host authorization permits; historical same-seed receipts may replace identical-input repeats, not mechanism contrasts. Also reserve 1200s for reporting and validation-only user-cluster bootstrap if identifiers are host-authorized. No test scores/predictions requested or used. Current proposal does not run training or assessment.
cost_plan.stop_rule: No local torch, raw data, GPU or training interface exists in this coding phase; only source/syntax checks now. Host preflight must check finite forward/backward at B=1 and mixed empty/nonempty and L=0/100; padding perturbations; target-action invariance; no-match endpoints; identical state_dict keys/values/shapes across arms; and I0T0 initial predictions and gradients against exact parent in float32 then bf16 (report max errors; suggested tolerances 1e-6 float32 and 5e-3 bf16). Profile the actual SDPA bias path before claiming feasibility. Stop if integrity checks fail, a complete admissible unit cannot fit the remaining ledger with reserves, the fixed trial cap is hit, or no useful contrast remains. Do not raise caps, install packages, change host contracts, silently optimize only an arm, or treat budget exhaustion as success. Any future optimized serving path needs prediction parity and separately measured cost.
